summary_rationale: AvePoint passes price-blind fundamental underwriting as a durable enterprise SaaS compounder. Over FY2020-FY2025 and through Q3 2026, it executed a disciplined mix shift from legacy perpetual/maintenance revenue to 76%-80% cloud-native SaaS, reaching $495.1M ARR (+27% YoY in Q3 2026) with 112% NRR, 90% GRR, 976 customers >$100K ARR, and a 44% Rule of 40 score. Channel/MSP distribution (57% of ARR; MSP ARR up 55% to $62M in FY25) provides capital-efficient mid-market scaling, while FY2025 delivered 74.1% GAAP gross margin, $33.0M GAAP operating income, $80.0M FCF (19.1% margin), $40.7M SBC-adjusted FCF, $418.3M cash (Q3 2026) with zero funded debt, and 16.8% ROIC. Primary structural risks to monitor are Microsoft native M365 Backup/Purview bundling, API/storage cost shifts, and G&A/SBC discipline.
